Name: Nyapu Style Seasonal Aymeric
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b][size=5][center]Aymeric- Nyapu Style by AhCuteArt[/center]
[/size][/b]
I adore Nyapu's style portraits and custom NPCs. My passion project at the moment is to create Nyapu style portraits for all the NPCs in my mega modded SDV file. I worked on Aymeric a while ago and just got around to finishing him. I hope you like him. 


[b]INSTALLATION (Must have Smapi):
[/b]
1. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23385]Aymeric de Borel - FFXIV[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23851]Aymeric de Borel - FFXIV - SVE Compatible[/url]﻿
2. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24347]Slightly Cuter Aymeric[/url]
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]There are Three files:[/b]
[Main File] CP is just a drag and drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go.

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits.
Slightly Cuter- manual replacement for Slightly Cuter Aymeric mod
Original- manual replacement for the original Aymeric de Borel

You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right. If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page. 
[b]
[/b][i][b]CREDITS:[/b]
BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art as a base.
Huge thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] for creating the Slightly Cuter Seasonal Series.
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/92368213]Adaire99[/url] for allowing me to retexture their mod.

[i][b]Shout out!:[/b][/i]
I wanted to highlight [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/155681583]SrenOrSomethin[/url] version here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35280]Nyapu Portrait for Slightly Cuter Aymeric[/url]. They did a great job, and their Aymeric is so much more expressive than mine. 
[b]
[i][b]What am I working on?:[/b][/i]
[/b][i]If you're curious what I am working on next, please check out my social media page or my Nexus profile. [/i][/i]
